name: tech.dojo.pay.uisdk.presentation.PaymentFlowContainerActivity
description: When the app starts the Dojo Pay drop-in payment UI, this Activity provides payment-method selection, card entry, saved-card management, and payment-result screens. It also connects the flow to Google Pay and virtual-terminal payment handlers.
disableEffect: Dojo's in-app payment screen cannot open, so its checkout flow cannot complete.
